name.zh: 高血压模式（食养指南折算）

note.zh: 《成人高血压食养指南（2023）》：每日钠 ≤2000mg（盐 <5g）。演示折算：每包（8g）承载日钠预算 7.5% → 150mg/包 → 1875mg/100g。折算份额为演示假设·待标定；经典 5 料盘在此档不可行（天花板 2608），扩展盘（I+G＋酸提咸＋掩蔽放松 KCl）可解——扩盘解锁更低钠档。
note.en: Adult Hypertension Dietary Guideline (2023): sodium ≤2000 mg/d (salt <5 g). Demo mapping: one 8 g packet carries 7.5% of the daily sodium budget → 150 mg/packet → 1875 mg/100 g. The share is a demo assumption, to be calibrated; infeasible on the classic palette (floor 2608), solvable on the extended palette (I+G + acid gain + masking-relaxed KCl) — expansion unlocks lower sodium.

provenance.source: 01-官方指南与政策文件《成人高血压食养指南（2023）》钠 ≤2000mg/日、盐 <5g/日

note.zh: 《成人慢性肾脏病食养指南（2024）》：限磷控钾方向。演示折算：钾 ≤3000mg/100g（每包 240mg）。KCl 代盐与乳酸钾掩蔽均带钾（524/305 mg/g）——控钾直接挤压 KCl 路线：本盘预计不可行，如实输出。临床口径：CKD 患者慎用低钠盐（代盐），正是该模式要演示的约束张力；可行路线只剩 I+G／酸提咸／微结构盐（§3.4 其余路线）。
note.en: Adult CKD Dietary Guideline (2024): limit phosphorus, control potassium. Demo mapping: K ≤3000 mg/100 g (240 mg/packet). Both KCl substitution and potassium-lactate masking carry potassium (524/305 mg/g) — capping K squeezes the KCl route out: expected infeasible on this palette, reported honestly. Clinically, CKD patients are advised against KCl salt substitutes; remaining routes are I+G / acid / microstructured salt (§3.4).

provenance.source: 01-官方指南与政策文件《成人慢性肾脏病食养指南（2024）》限磷控钾条款；钾折算为演示假设·待标定

name.zh: 现实纯盐基线（12% 纯盐）

note.zh: 双基准并报（库纪律）：对 LP 解基线（钠上限 4716 行的最优解，含少量 KCl）与对纯盐基线的代价必须同时报。LP 解基线成本由求解器实时计算（四舍五入前精确值 ≈ 0.30206）。
note.en: Dual-baseline reporting (library discipline): cost deltas vs the LP-solution baseline (optimum at the 4716 cap, includes a little KCl) and vs the pure-salt baseline must be reported together. The LP baseline cost is computed live (exact pre-rounding value ≈ 0.30206).

schema_1plus6.zh: GB 28050「1+6」全约束：钠为已验证主约束；能量/蛋白质/脂肪/饱和脂肪/碳水/糖 6 项 v0.2 起挂文献典型值系数（演示级·待标定），可开关激活——多目标/ε-约束的数学形状落地，不伪造精度。
schema_1plus6.en: GB 28050 '1+6' full constraints: sodium is the verified primary constraint; since v0.2 the other six carry literature-typical coefficients (demo-grade, to-be-calibrated) behind a switch — the multi-objective / ε-constraint shape made real, without fabricating precision.

name.zh: 演示档（常规调料包形状）

note.zh: 全部演示值：常规调料包应可行且 6 行皆有松弛（对偶报告显示距门槛余量），展示 6 行同时入模的形状；蛋白质行下限 0（本品类无蛋白声称）。
note.en: All demo values: a typical pack stays feasible with slack on all six rows (the dual report shows headroom); protein floor is 0 (no protein claim for this category).

name.zh: GB 声称档（无糖＋低脂＋低饱和脂肪）

note.zh: 糖 0.5／脂肪 3／饱和脂肪 1.5 按 GB 28050「无糖／低脂（固体）／低饱和脂肪」声称门槛；能量/蛋白/碳水沿用演示值（本品类该三项声称无意义）。无糖门槛将迫使白砂糖退出、甜味需另行满足——正是 ε-约束开关要展示的形状变化。
note.en: Sugar 0.5 / fat 3 / saturates 1.5 follow GB 28050 claim thresholds (sugar-free / low-fat solid / low-saturates); energy/protein/carb keep demo values (no meaningful claims for this category). The sugar-free threshold forces sugar out and sweetness must be met otherwise — exactly the shape change the ε-constraint switch demonstrates.
